liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **China Cat Sunflower** (3 reviews): Reviewer calls this China>Rider outrageous, with Phil playing like a man possessed; Reviewer loves Jerry's unique jam in China>Rider, unlike any other heard [15][16][18]
- **He's Gone** (3 reviews): Reviewer singles out the sequence from Scarlet Begonias through He's Gone, Truckin', Other One jam, Space and Stella Blue; Garcia plays slide guitar during He's Gone, which the reviewer says never heard elsewhere [12][15][16]
- **Mississippi Half Step Uptown Toodeloo** (2 reviews): Reviewer ranks the Half-Step>Roses among the best ever, and Big River as very energetic [15][16]
- **Seastones (Phil and Ned)** (1 review): Reviewer found the Phil and Ned Seastones segment a standout, a long strange trip [9]
- **Truckin'** (1 review): Truckin' jam explores Other One themes and feedback like screaming whales, close to a Dark Star moment [8]

## Setlist highlights

- **Stella Blue**(Matrix**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [19]
- **Audience)**: rare: 12 archived performances [19]

## The recordings

- **gd1974-08-05.131660.mtx.dusborne.flac16** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 25 songs; 229 min; rated 4.88/5 by 8 [1]
- **gd74-08-05.aud.weiner.21294.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 24 songs; 228 min; rated 4.14/5 by 14 [2]. Said about its sound: Reviewer finds the audience recording possibly too quiet, and partly rejects it, though admits lacking engineering knowledge [10]
- **gd1974-08-05.151039.sbd.eaton-miller.flac1644**: soundboard; 24 songs; 198 min; rated 3.33/5 by 3 [5]
- **gd74-08-05.sbd.sacks.1826.sbeok.shnf**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 24 songs; 209 min; rated 4.43/5 by 7 [3]

## Around the show

- Stage announcements about matches and explosives are audible on the audience recording by Jerry Moore [8]
- A fan ran across the stage right after U.S. Blues and kissed Jerry Garcia's ear [11]
- Only Miami and Philadelphia got two-night stands on the 1974 summer tour; reviewer ranks this second night a keeper [7]
- Reviewer says highlights fall short of the first night's Weather Report Suite, jam and Playin'; the second set's middle is best [10]
- Reviewer values the standalone Scarlet Begonias of 1974 for their special quality, and thinks Jerry's guitar chops peaked that year [12]
- Dick's Picks 31 omits much good material; this show begins one of the best two-show runs the reviewer has heard [18]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1974-08-05.131660.mtx.dusborne.flac16**: transferred by Matrix by Dave Usborne; source: 2 Source Matrix by Dusborne; Soundboard (shnid:108814) MSR>C>C>DAT DAT @ 48k - > HT OMega 7.1 Soundcard (Optical Inputs)>WAV (48)> Syntillium Cool Edit… [1]
- **gd74-08-05.aud.weiner.21294.sbeok.shnf**: taped by Jerry Moore; transferred by Noah Weiner; source: Audience Recording [2]. Also: Jerry Moore taped the audience recording; Noel Weiner put it on etree; the soundboard was later removed from the Archive after Dick's Picks 31 [13]
- **gd1974-08-05.151039.sbd.eaton-miller.flac1644**: taped by Rob Eaton and Dick Latvala; transferred by Original Transfer and Mastering by Rob Eaton Additional Mastering by Charlie Miller  December 4, 2020; source: SBD > Reel Master (7in 7.5ips 1/2trk) > Cassette (Tascam 122mkIII/TDK SA-X100) [5]. Also: Source from Rob Eaton and Dick Latvala, patched with Jerry Moore, Mark Cohen and Noah Weiner's audience source; pitch checked by Joe B. Jones [5]
- **gd74-08-05.sbd.sacks.1826.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Darrin Sacks; source: Soundboard with audience patches [3]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Jerry Garcia: [Grateful Dead Poster 1974-08-05 - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/image/grateful-dead-poster-1974-08-05-05/) [25]
